transcript.content:
Now I have a clear understanding of the issue. The warning at line 2227 of `tokenization_utils_base.py` is raised whenever `padding=True` and `max_length` is not None, saying "`max_length` is ignored when `padding`=`True`." But this is incorrect when `truncation=True` is also passed — in that case, `max_length` IS used for truncation. The warning should only be shown when `max_length` is truly being ignored (i.e., when truncation is not also enabled).

The fix is to modify the condition at line 2226 to check that truncation is not also enabled before issuing the warning.
